author: MCSL05

title: This as good as it gets / totally recommended
body:
I needed to follow up specific symptoms and some of them are subjective, so you really need to take care on certain aspects, take notes and so, for proper interpretation by healthcare specialists.

I logged stuff during bit more than 8 months and really the info you can get is very useful, it really made the difference.

Apart from the great graphs of correlations that are fairly customisable, that together with the export data that I fed to AI, I was able to catch things that wouldn’t have noticed in any other way.

Beautiful functional app. The phone is not only to play games and watch photos haha It can be a great tool with the right mindset behind the design of an app like this one. The creator are nailing it.

title: Has to get better but it’s good
body: It is quite useful. But when you see the results, you can’t know if you have felt someway because of something you did or you did the thing because you were feeling that way. So it will give me conclusions like: when you do meditation you tend to be angrier, (because this two happen on the same time). and whats happening is exactly the opposite, I do meditation when I’m angry, and what I want to see is the effect on later. Anyway, is the more complete app I’ve found for tracking. I hope they can adjust this a little bit, maybe with a timeline instead of time periods
author: Silvirose

title: Free won’t get you far
body: I would love to support the app if it wasn’t a subscription. If you’re only mildly interested in how your symptoms tie together with various factors, the free version of the app is pretty useless. It’s a bit of a shame.
